explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/611: Bollobás–Erdős proved that if every maximal clique has ≥ n + 3 − 2√n vertices then τ(G) = 1. The statement asserts this for all n and G on Fin n. For n ≤ 2 the hypothesis is unsatisfiable, so there are no spurious small cases. For n ≥ 3 every maximal clique is big, so ignoring 1-vertex cliques in τ is harmless. Faithful.
